home.body: Cybersecurity is everyone's responsibility — not just IT's. This portal gives every PAC team member the knowledge and instincts to protect themselves, their colleagues, and our clients.
home.step1Desc: Build and spot phishing emails in our interactive game.
home.step2Desc: Learn the 4 tactics and 5 types of attack.
home.step3Desc: Clean desk, passwords, remote work, and more.
home.step4Desc: Score 80% to earn your PAC certificate.
home.gameTitle: PhishCraft — Build it. Spot it. Survive it.
home.gameDesc: Two modes: craft a phishing email to understand the tactics, or spot the phish to test your instincts.
home.whyMattersBody: Most incidents start with one message that looks normal. This training gives you the skills to spot phishing quickly and report it the PAC way—so you protect yourself, PAC, and our customers.
home.whyMattersCard1Body: Prevent account takeovers and identity misuse. A 10‑second pause can save hours of cleanup.
home.whyMattersCard2Body: Phishing leads to stolen credentials, invoice fraud, and system access. Fast reporting helps IT stop campaigns early.
home.whyMattersCard3Body: Customers trust us with their information. Strong habits reduce the risk of data exposure and protect relationships.
home.phishingDesc: Urgency, Intimidation, Scarcity, Authority — and the five attack types used against PAC every day.
home.itDesc: Clean desk, password hygiene, AUP, physical security, social media, remote work, and incident reporting.
home.todayTitle: Do this today — 5 minutes, right now
home.todaySubtitle: The most effective thing training can do is lead to immediate action.
home.today1: Check MFA is enabled on your Microsoft 365 account. Contact IT if it isn't.
home.today2: Press Win+L or Cmd+Ctrl+Q right now. Practice the habit.
home.today3: Is your work password unique — not used anywhere else? If not, change it.
home.today4: Find the Barracuda Outlook Add‑In in the Add-ins section of your Outlook ribbon before you need it.
home.today5: Any passwords written down? Any sensitive docs visible? Clear them today.
